test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Formal health education is important for women for various reasons listed below. Which of the following is an INCORRECT option with regard to formal health education in women?

options.text: Provides knowledge about sexually transmitted diseases
Provides information about nutritional needs of children
Helps to reduce child and maternal deaths
Empowers them to decide about child bearing

solution:
The correct answer is __**Empowers them to decide about child bearing.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Formal health education** provides knowledge about **sexually transmitted diseases,** which is important for women to** protect themselves** and their partners from infections.
 
• It also provides information about **nutritional needs** of children, which is important for women to ensure that their children grow up** healthy and strong.**
 
• Formal health education helps to **reduce child and maternal deaths** by teaching women about the importance of prenatal care, safe delivery practices, and postnatal care for both the mother and the child.
 
• Empowering women to decide about child bearing is also an important aspect of formal health education, as it enables them to make informed choices about their **reproductive health and family planning.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Sexually transmitted diseases** (STDs) are infections that are passed from one person to another through **sexual contact.**

 
 
• Formal health education can provide information on how to** prevent and treat STDs,** as well as how to reduce the risk of transmission.
 
 
 
• **Nutritional needs** of children vary depending on their** age, gender, and activity level.**
 
 
• Formal health education can provide information on how to meet these needs through a** balanced diet and healthy eating habits.**
 
 
 
• **Child and maternal deaths **are a major public health concern, particularly in **low-income countries. **
 
 
• **​**Formal health education can help to address this issue by improving access to **healthcare services** and promoting** healthy behaviors.**
 
 
 
• Empowering women to make decisions about **child bearing **can have a positive impact on their health and well-being, as well as that of their families.
 
 
• This can include access to** family planning services, education** on contraception methods, and support for safe and healthy pregnancies.
